CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates) and its presentation (red/blue partition) and origin/status (copied_prior_record) are all explicitly provided for the same p0/current/n1 referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified represented contents (coordinate sets) labeled by color.

D.rationale: The origin field (e.g. copied_prior_record) separately attributes a status/source to the identified content.

O.rationale: The text specifies how content is presented as organized color-labeled coordinate partitions (current).
